run_stsp_prediction: run distributed STSP prediction for speech-text or text-speech tasks using SpiritLM model
get_eval_classifier: get the appropriate emotion or sentiment classifier based on input-output modality type
get_sentiment: get predicted sentiment from generated speech audio or text using a loaded classifier
write_jsonl: write a dictionary of predictions to a JSONL file with one record per line
write_wav: write a numpy audio waveform to a WAV file with a random UUID filename
